risk_summary: The disclosure is largely quantitative and transparent, reporting sales declines, product-line performance, margins, inventory judgments, tax uncertainty, and liquidity details. Risk is moderate: fiscal 2024 revenue declined and a planned HPMS product launch was delayed, while profitability, cash resources, covenant compliance, and available credit support a generally stable financial position. Forward-looking estimates remain sensitive to demand, product acceptance, inventory valuation, tax settlements, supply-chain conditions, and capital requirements.
